description: For every valuation \(v\), atom \(p\), Boolean \(b\), and CNF \(\Gamma\), the valuation \(v[p:=b]\) satisfies \(\Gamma\) exactly when \(v\) satisfies \(R_{p,b}(\Gamma)\).
signature:
Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.DpllSatisfiability.setting_models.{u} {α : Type u} [DecidableEq α] (p : α) (b : Bool)
  (v : Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.Propositional.Valuation α)
  (Γ : Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.DpllSatisfiability.Cnf α) :
  Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.DpllSatisfiability.Models (Function.update v p b) Γ ↔
    Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.DpllSatisfiability.Models v
      (Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.DpllSatisfiability.setting p b Γ)
